source: docs/research/reports/14-level2-layout.md Tasks and Map variants; the map variants M22 to M24 are prop states: smashed fuses turn the barrier (col 99) off and pull the bridge (col 52 blocker), the fitted fuse turns both back on; the fuse fits as soon as the hero has it, as in the original (fitted before the teleport repair, the barrier comes back and locks the hero east: the original soft-lock, kept, user); the teleport link needs both the power and the repaired teleport, so restorePower and repairTeleport each come twice under one id: the first entry runs when the other part is already done and links the teleports, the second runs alone; tasks sharing an id close together
